about.en: DFDV xStock (DFDVx) is a tokenized tracker certificate on DeFi Development Corp. shares issued by Backed under the xStocks brand. Each token is backed 1:1 by DFDV shares held with regulated custodians and tracks the share price on-chain; it is offered to non-US investors. It is the SPL token Xs2yquAgsHByNzx68WJC55WHjHBvG9JsMB7CWjTLyPy on Solana and the ERC-20 at 0x521860bB5dF5468358875266B89BFE90d990C6e7 on Ethereum, BNB Chain and Arbitrum.
